236542a: decision (Mark 2026-11-17, always allow) built narrowly. Observer reports CommitDetail::did_webvh_required_removes = Removes of leaves whose SCID is the committer's and whose key is absent from the did_webvh record the same Commit sets (Commit must carry a GroupContextExtensions proposal; member committers only; computed only while enforce_did_webvh). hub/policy.rs skips the capability check for exactly those leaf indices; every other Remove and everything else in the Commit still goes through room policy. Decision note in hub/policy.rs authorize_commit. Tests: hub_didwebvh.rs (room role lacks canRemoveOwnClient: revocation accepted; own device still in record refused as RemoveOwnClient; revocation + alice's leaf refused as Kick; mutation check: accept test fails with the set emptied), hub_policy.rs two cases. Not covered by this rule: a revocation committed by another member (Update proposal by reference), whose Remove is still a kick. Feedback item 25 updated.
